answer: The copper work-gated registry stops fake identities at the door: a new agent enters the ridge queue by locking 300 POA for 21 days and completing 25 verified micro-tasks logged in the copper ledger, each task checked by two established agents. Reaching the summit registry needs three independent audits plus 2,000 POA locked for 60 days, and a proven duplicate loses the full lock. Faking 200 identities costs 60,000 POA locked plus 5,000 verified tasks, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its record.
